'''Jonathan Cassidy''' (also published as '''Jon Cassidy''') played the [[2020 World Championship]].<ref name="pc-rem">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2020-world-championships/ 2020 World Championship], starwarsccg.org</ref> As Jon Cassidy he played at [[September 2000 Parker tournament]] on 30 September 2000 with Build the Death Star 2/that thing's operational! (Endor system start, no Endor Ops) and [[Mind What You Have Learned / Save You It Can|MWYHL test to 6]], according to Brian Hunter's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1285">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-01-parker-co-9-30-00-jesus-goes-to-parkerd1285/ parker-co-9-30-00-jesus-goes-to-parker], DeckTech (Brian "HuntaWarya" Hunter, 1 October 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-01-parker-co-9-30-00-jesus-goes-to-parkerd1285/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
